run_moolib_all_reduce_test: run the test_reduce.py script to test moolib all_reduce across 4 clients
create_moolib_rpc_client: create an moolib Rpc client that connects to a broker address with a name and timeout
create_moolib_broker: create an moolib Broker with an Rpc instance and listen on a local address
